cannibalisation_rules: /ai-business-audit owns the cross-functional lead magnet and digital business diagnostic narrative.
Do not launch a separate /business-health-check until it has a distinct paid scope and enough unique evidence.
/automation owns CRM and marketing workflow assessment, not generic AI automation.
Industry pages require verified use cases and unique content; no doorway pages.

primary.description: Swiss owner-led service SMEs and B2B service firms with an existing website, meaningful lead value and no reliable view of where digital demand leaks.
traits: roughly 5–50 employees or equivalent operational maturity
existing website, Google profile and some demand-generation activity
leads matter more than ecommerce checkout volume
multiple hand-offs between website, email/phone, CRM and follow-up
ability to fund implementation after a credible audit

secondary: agencies, consultants and IT providers needing a partner or white-label diagnostic
SMEs already spending on SEO or Ads but lacking clean tracking and follow-up
later: gastronomy and very small local operators
avoid_at_launch: pre-revenue ideas without a working website or implementation budget
firms seeking guaranteed Google or ChatGPT rankings
generic AI transformation without a defined use case
low-value consumer leads that cannot support a high-touch audit
regulated or enterprise work beyond the current security and delivery system
